text:
maria: heads up — after the KMS key policy tweak this morning some APAC GPU nodes are failing to join the cluster. seeing `InstanceProvisionFailed` in the ASG events and node bootstrap stalls during decrypt of the AMI.

owen: which key/policy was changed? link to the PR?

maria: PR #3214 by infra-sec. they tightened cross-account decrypts on the `gpu-images` CMK. commit: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/3214

raj: that was intentional for compliance, but we expected to add an exception for the autoscale IAM role. looks like the exception didn't land. I'm checking the key policy now.

jen: examples of what we're seeing in the ASG events:

```
2026-10-03T09:12:02Z - AutoScalingGroup launching instance i-0abc123
2026-10-03T09:12:45Z - Instance i-0abc123 failed to decrypt volume: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gpu-autoscale-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
```

maria: confirmed. cloud-init is doing `aws kms decrypt` to unwrap the AMI volume key during boot.

owen: immediate mitigation: can we re-grant `kms:Decrypt` to the role for that CMK and then trigger a rolling replace? we need capacity now.

raj: I can patch the key policy to add the role ARN for a short window. but we need auditors on the loop—will tag in KMS audit bot.

kms-audit-bot: @raj Please provide justification and a TTL for the temporary exception. All changes will be recorded in the KMS audit trail.

raj: adding: "justification: urgent rollback to restore cluster capacity. TTL: 2 hours. requestor: raj@redwood"

jen: can we also prevent new ASG launches from hitting problematic AMIs while we fix the policy? i'd rather avoid repeated failures.

owen: yes — set ASG to use the fallback AMI (non-encrypted) and suspend `Launch` process for 10 minutes. command:

```
aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-workers-apac --launch-configuration-name gpu-workers-fallback-lc
aws autoscaling suspend-processes --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-workers-apac --scaling-processes Launch
```

maria: doing that now. switching to fallback LC. will also open a quota ticket to avoid hitting on-demand limits in other regions.

jen: note — fallback AMI is CPU-optimized, so perf will suffer and token costs for some workloads will spike. finance FYI: cost impact likely +18% for next 6h if sustained.

maria: rolling replace started. deploy-bot: trigger rolling-replace gpu-workers-apac by maria

deploy-bot: rolling replace started (job id: rr-20261003-92). will sequentially terminate and replace up to 2 instances at a time.

owen: after we restore the key policy, what's the plan to get back to encrypted AMIs without blipping production? can we warm a few encrypted nodes in a canary ASG?

raj: plan: 1) patch key policy to add role for 2h; 2) heal existing failed launches; 3) create a canary ASG with the encrypted AMI (capacity 3) in a non-critical pool; 4) monitor boot logs + CloudTrail for any other denied decrypts; 5) remove the exception and update infra PR with a scoped cross-account condition.

jen: please include the exact KMS policy snippet we'll use so we can pre-authorize and have auditors approve. suggested minimal change:

```
{
  "Sid": "AllowGPUAutoScaleRoleDecrypt",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gpu-autoscale-role"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {
    "StringEquals": {"kms:ViaService": "ec2.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com"}
  }
}
```

raj: that looks reasonable but auditors want a narrower `kms:ViaService` + `aws:SourceAccount` condition. i'll draft a hardened version and ping security.

maria: audit logs — where should we look for a list of denied decrypt attempts? CloudTrail or KMS event logs?

jen: both. quick filter:

```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --region ap-southeast-1 --start-time 2026-10-03T08:00:00Z
```

owen: i'm seeing a spike in deny events ~09:12 UTC. tally so far: ~28 failed decrypts across 3 AZs.

maria: that's consistent with the ASG retries. thx. we're also seeing a couple of nodes fall back to other regions briefly which caused some cross-region data egress alerts — security flagged it.

raj: I'll annotate the change in the CMK's change log and request a short emergency exception via the compliance flow. auditors: @raj @maria please ack when you get the ticket.

kms-audit-bot: KMS change submitted (ticket KMS-EMG-88). Please attach justification and TTL.

maria: attached logs and the proposed policy. setting TTL to 2 hours starting now.

jen: once the canary is healthy, we should run a smoke test to validate model latency and GPU utilization before scaling the encrypted ASG back up.

owen: agree. also adding a monitoring alert to catch `kms:Decrypt` denies going forward. rule: if >5 denies in 5m in ap-southeast-1, page infra oncall.

maria: done — alert created in Grafana (rule id: infra-kms-decrypt-deny-apac). paging threshold set.

jen: quick postmortem items: (1) add KMS policy change checklist (include roles used by ASG/cloud-init), (2) preflight script to test `aws kms decrypt` with the autoscale role, (3) restrict deploy window for KMS policy changes to low-impact hours unless emergency.

owen: i'll create the preflight script PR after this stabilizes. example test command:

```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gpu-autoscale-role --role-session-name test
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://wrapped_key.bin --region ap-southeast-1
```

maria: rolling replace finished. capacity recovered to target but still on fallback LC. canary creation next.

raj: patched key policy for 2h window. canary ASG launched (3 encrypted nodes) — boot logs show successful decrypts.

jen: canary healthy after 12m. latency within 2% of baseline. i'm promoting encrypted AMI back to primary pool in small steps.

maria: removing fallback LC and resuming Launch processes. please monitor cost — finance noted the earlier spike.

owen: thanks everyone. we'll follow up with a short postmortem and a tightened key policy PR that uses `kms:ViaService`, `aws:SourceAccount`, and a tag-based condition on the AMI.

maria: thanks — filing postmortem draft now: https://go.redwood/pm/postmortems/KMS-EMG-88

jen: adding action items to the incident board. :white_check_mark:

kms-audit-bot: Audit trail: change logged. Reminder: All emergency exceptions must have an owner and TTL."
